history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration formulate an amendment to information circular ST/IC/2019/16 to provide updated guidance on the arrangement of travel outside the Umoja travel module.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. Travel arrangements processed outside the Umoja travel module occur only in limited and exceptional circumstances and are necessary to meet operational requirements. These cases are already subject to existing financial and administrative controls, including based on the mutual recognition principle signed by the Secretary- General and other executive heads. Additional guidance on the utilization of fund commitments in Umoja was issued on 31 October 2025.
history.board_assessment: Given that guidelines on the utilization of fund commitments in Umoja were issued on 31 October 2025, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
